SEARCH

All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractWidget
Convenient base class for widgets that render a Swing JPanel in 3D.
BuiltinWidgetCards
The catalogue of built-in widget cards (clock, calendar, temperature, CPU, memory, system indicators and weather), as pure-Swing WidgetCardSpecs.
BuiltinWidgetProvider
Contributes the widgets bundled with the lg3d-widgets module (clock, calendar, temperature, CPU, memory, system indicators and weather) to the WidgetRegistry.
CalendarCard
A month calendar for the desktop: the 3D counterpart of the 2D taskbar clock's CalendarPopup.
CalendarWidget
The 3D desktop's calendar widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing CalendarCard in a SwingNode.
ClockCard
A desktop clock with analog and digital faces.
ClockWidget
The 3D desktop's clock widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing ClockCard in a SwingNode and forwards the click that toggles the analog/digital face.
CpuCard
Live CPU load with a small sparkline of recent history.
CpuWidget
The 3D desktop's CPU-load widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing CpuCard in a SwingNode.
MemoryCard
Used/total RAM plus swap, from SystemInfoService.memory().
MemoryWidget
The 3D desktop's memory widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing MemoryCard in a SwingNode.
SwingWidgetLayer
The conventional-Swing desktop's widget layer: the 2D counterpart of the 3D WidgetHost/WidgetLayer.
SystemIndicatorsCard
The system-indicator cluster - network link, master volume, screen brightness and battery charge - as a glassy widget card.
SystemIndicatorsWidget
The 3D desktop's system-indicators widget (network / volume / brightness / battery): a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing SystemIndicatorsCard in a SwingNode.
TemperatureCard
Shows CPU/system temperature from ThermalService.
TemperatureWidget
The 3D desktop's temperature widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing TemperatureCard in a SwingNode and forwards the click that cycles the sensor zones.
ToastCard3D
One notification toast card in the 3D desktop: a fixed-size, opaque Swing card (accent stripe by Notification.Kind, bold title, dimmed body) hosted on a SwingNode.
ToastOverlay3D
The 3D desktop's notification toast stack: a pool of up to ToastQueue.DEFAULT_MAX_VISIBLE ToastCard3D cards anchored in the bottom-right of the front-most DesktopHudLayer, newest at the bottom and stacked upward.
ToastOverlayPlugin
Scene-manager plugin that mounts the notification toast stack on the front-most desktop HUD layer.
WeatherCard
Current weather for a city, fetched from the free Open-Meteo forecast API (no API key).
WeatherWidget
The 3D desktop's weather widget: a thin AbstractWidget that hosts the pure-Swing WeatherCard in a SwingNode and forwards the click (toggle °C/°F) and mouse-wheel (cycle city) gestures.
Widget
A pluggable desktop widget.
WidgetCard
The pure-Swing face of a desktop widget: a glassy card that owns its own model, its periodic WidgetCard.tick() update, its painting and its click / mouse-wheel interaction.
WidgetCardSpec
Immutable, Java 3D-free metadata describing a kind of widget card, plus a factory that creates instances of it.
WidgetConfigStore
Persists the desktop widget layout to ${user.home}/.config/lg3d/widgets.properties.
WidgetContext
Runtime services handed to a widget in Widget.init(WidgetContext).
WidgetDescriptor
Immutable metadata describing a kind of widget, plus a factory that creates instances of it.
WidgetGallery
A small application that lists every widget type discovered by the WidgetRegistry and lets the user add instances to (or remove them from) the live desktop widget layer.
WidgetGalleryPanel
The conventional-Swing desktop's widget gallery: the pure-Swing counterpart of the 3D org.jdesktop.lg3d.widgets.gallery.WidgetGallery.
WidgetHost
Owns the set of widget instances on the desktop: creates them from the WidgetRegistry, places them on the WidgetLayer, makes them draggable, and persists the layout (which instances, their types and positions) through a WidgetConfigStore.
WidgetLayer
The desktop widget layer: a screen-sized Container3D placed in front of the background and behind application windows.
WidgetLayerPlugin
Scene-manager plugin that puts the desktop widget layer on the scene.
WidgetPanel
Shared base panel for the built-in widgets: paints a dark, rounded, glassy card with a small title, then delegates the body to WidgetPanel.paintContent(java.awt.Graphics2D, int, int, int).
WidgetProvider
Service-provider interface for contributing widgets.
WidgetRegistry
Aggregates every WidgetProvider visible on the classpath (via ServiceLoader) into a single lookup of WidgetDescriptors.
